text_block_list.text:
Another loss added to the streak... As I 
tried to analyze what went wrong and 
reached for the waiting room door—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Why...! Why can't I win?! How did it... 
turn out like this...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even though I've worked so hard!! I 
definitely worked harder than the girl who 
came in 1st...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
choice_data_list:
I understand why you'd want to blame 
someone.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
choice_data_list: That's just how devoted your efforts are.
That's just how devoted your efforts are.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not true. It's just that my 
heart is weak, is all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"If it's just that my ability wasn't 
enough... then—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I will put in even more effort. So that 
next time... I can seize victory!
choice_data_list: I know you can spread your wings and soar.

I'm sure you can spread your wings and 
soar.

Then let's find the areas for improvement 
and work on them together!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I will put in even more effort. So that 
next time... I can seize victory!
choice_data_list: I know you can spread your wings and soar.

soar.

Then let's find the areas for improvement 
and work on them together!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'll fight with all I have, so 
that I can spread my wings and soar.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I might still be weak, but... I want to 
stand back up. I don't wanna give up.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Becoming the star has always been my 
dream!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I won't run away. I'll face whatever 
problems come my way!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's not anyone else's fault. I will get 
stronger and take 1st place!
